summary: Added a scan-friendly Docker detail surface with metadata sections, on-demand bounded logs, action progress, and direct navigation from registered services to their associated container.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Ports, mounts, networks, labels, and logs are restricted to detail.
Detail includes overview, ports, storage, networks, labels, services, and on-demand logs.
Service tiles provide View container for a present manual association; missing associations remain visibly missing.

notes: No automatic service-to-container association was introduced.
